description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView adapter called NavigationAdapter for rendering a horizontal navigation bar in an Android application. It manages a list of navigation items, visual states (active/inactive), and user interactions like clicks and focus navigation.

classes.name: NavigationAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying a horizontal navigation bar with items that can be activated and focused, handling user interactions and visual styling based on state.

classes.name: NavigationAdapter.NavViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder inner class managing individual navigation item views and their click behavior.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new NavViewHolder instance by inflating the navigation item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the view holder, updating styles and states based on whether the item is active.
